meta.name: Realm Boss Overhaul
meta.notes: 8 bosses rebuilt at 32px+ with 3 phases each. Sheets are prefixed bx_ and nothing here reuses a name from pack 1 (atlas.json) or Expansion One (atlas_expansion.json); these replace the old 16x16 bosses. x5 frames are 5x nearest-neighbour with a 1px outline (+1px padding per side). Every frame of a boss has the same size, so draw each frame centred on the boss position. 'phases' lists each phase's idle and attack loops, the morph animation that plays when the phase begins, and the shots it fires. Shots point right; rotate them to the direction of travel.
